title: Part Fourteen: Myths, Contested Claims and What Is Settled

sections.brief: Ledger of claims judged documented / contested / unsupported / myth from Parts One to Thirteen: Scofield created Christian Zionism (myth; restorationism, Darby, Niagara, Blackstone predate him; precondition claim fails); convicted forger (myth; jailed awaiting trial, nolle prosequi 6 Nov 1879; one divorce); Untermyer and the Rothschild variant (myth; Lotos Club only, Canfield 'we assume' 1988, Piper 2004; trope named; documented funders); 1917 edition and Balfour (unsupported); tens of millions of Scofield copies (unsupported; ~2m by 1945; Lindsey and Left Behind are the tens of millions); 'a land without a people' (Christian coinage; slogan use and meaning contested); want Jews to die or convert (texts vs stated positions, both sides); evangelicals set US policy (contested: embassy, Golan, settlements, limits); Kairos 'heresy' (unsupported; the 2006 Declaration's 'false teaching'); Learjet and Osirak call (not found); extras (MacDonald origin, Balfour as Christian Zionist act, CUFI membership, Catholic ruling on Scofield, Truman's Cyrus). Figures: compare (ledger)

What the record settles (lineage 1609-1909; the machine and its money as filed: committees, Moral Majority, ICEJ, IFCJ 990s, CUFI Action Fund, self-reported membership, Adelson per +972, Israel's 2025 church campaign; the shield's documented uses by named people and officials; its documented failures; the generational split with dated polls LifeWay 2017, Inbari-Bumin 2018-21, Pew May 2026); what is contested (motives: Balfour, Truman, Posner vs CUFI; influence on policy: the embassy cause); what is open as of 21 October 2026 (shift's direction, CUFI's main finances and count, unchecked sources, Latin American belief, Honduras, settlements position, MOU successor, IS-RA-EL origin); the central question answered; closing paragraph on Part Thirteen's lens kept labelled as a reading. Figures: compare (Settled / Contested / Open); time (1621-2026)
